method:
Execute original PAGE/DELTA envelopes against one synthetic owner/context.

Original proprietary owners, protobuf constructors, string assignments and wire
serializer execute unchanged. Opaque HTTP interfaces capture their arguments;
DELTA's backend sync-token getter returns an explicit synthetic string. Each
owner stops after its original native-context wrapper returns, before callbacks
or dispatch. No Dart encoder, application, profile, account or network is used.

proved: Each pair executes PAGE and DELTA on exactly the same synthetic owner, template slot and native-context value.

Both original envelopes clone owner+0x78, retain inherited sentinel header values/origin, set POST, set Accept and Content-Type to the identical CollectionV2 MIME, set regional_routing=true and forward owner+0x68 through the original context wrapper.

The explicit envelope differences before the stop are PAGE vs DELTA path and original serialized body. DELTA obtains field3 from backend virtual+0x18; PAGE obtains its page token from owner+0xd0 and supplies limit300.

All five PAGE bodies also match the retained independently executed original PAGE byte fixture exactly. DELTA bodyHex is produced by the original constructor/assignments/serializer, not any substitute wire encoder.
substitutedInterfaces: HTTP template clone captures explicit synthetic inherited fields.
Relative path, method, opaque body and header setters capture original arguments.
Request-inner virtual+0x58 captures original regional_routing property strings; the original 0x101c1fc50 wrapper executes unchanged.
Request-inner virtual+0xc8 captures explicit native-context input; original 0x101c20210 executes unchanged.
DELTA owner+0x50 virtual+0x18 returns an explicit synthetic libc++ sync-token string through hidden result x8; its admission/storage/provider provenance is not inferred.
PAGE and DELTA stop at101b3d230 and101b3d9b0 respectively, immediately after original101c20210 returns, before callback construction or send.
standardProviders: Inherited OriginalAudioFilesRequest pinned allocation, libc/libc++ string and memory imports.
One-thread libc++ shared-pointer mutex imports retain the real null-shared-pointer branch.
Darwin TLV bootstrap uses a synthetic thread; original protobuf constructor, runtime and wire serializer execute unchanged.
limits: Constructor101b3afdc parameter-to-owner bindings are retained static original-source/instruction evidence; this oracle injects the shaped owner instead of executing the full service constructor.

HTTP template clone/setters and request-inner interfaces are capture providers; concrete HTTP backend/provider construction, final header normalization/order, auth population, origin selection and transport execution are not exercised.

The shared service envelope is executed, closing only that part of the PAGE/DELTA composition boundary. No actual H3 PAGE send, H3 selection/timing, QPACK behavior or server acceptance is established.
Synthetic inherited Cache-Control is preserved as an arbitrary sentinel; this does not make it an original production cache default. Ordered builder observations are not decoded H3 header order.
Empty username/set/sync-token inputs prove serialization only. The enclosing original admission branches, managed stores, sync scheduling, retries, callbacks and responses are excluded.
PAGE and DELTA also update owner flags at+0x101/+0x102, retained per-stage; no claim that the full service state machines are identical.
No Dart, remote sender, original process/profile/account access or network is used.
